versos.texto_bv: Doeg, o edomita, que estava entre os servos de Saul, respondeu: “Vi o filho de Jessé chegar a Nobe e ir até Aimeleque, filho de Aitube.
versos.traducao_literal: E respondeu Doeg, o edomita, e ele estava posto sobre os servos de Saul, e disse: “Vi o filho de Jessé vindo a Nobe, a Aimeleque, filho de Aitube.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0022): 'נִצָּב עַל' (particípio nifal + preposição 'sobre') indica posição de chefia/supervisão ('posto sobre, encarregado de'), não mera copresença entre pares. A texto_bv traduz 'que estava entre os servos de Saul', o que rebaixa Doeg a um dos servos comuns, quando o hebraico e a própria camada literal da BV indicam que ele estava posto EM AUTORIDADE sobre os servos de Saul. Corrigir a preposição/verbo mudaria o sentido do texto atual (de par para superior hierárquico), por isso fica registrado como objeção, sem alteração do texto. — evidência: traducao_literal: 'e ele estava posto sobre os servos de Saul'; KJV: 'which was set over the servants of Saul' — ambas as fontes de controle apontam posição de chefia ('sobre'), não de mera participação ('entre').

kjv.texto: Then answered Doeg the Edomite, which was set over the servants of Saul, and said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

vizinhos.8: That all of you have conspired against me, and there is none that sheweth me that my son hath made a league with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you that is sorry for me, or sheweth unto me that my son hath stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?
vizinhos.10: And he enquired of the Lord for him, and gave him victuals, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.

web.texto: Then Doeg the Edomite, who stood by the servants of Saul, answered and said, “I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech the son of Ahitub.

vizinhos.8: that all of you have conspired against me, and there is no one who discloses to me when my son makes a treaty with the son of Jesse, and there is none of you who is sorry for me, or discloses to me that my son has stirred up my servant against me, to lie in wait, as at this day?”
vizinhos.10: He inquired of Yahweh for him, gave him food, and gave him the sword of Goliath the Philistine.”
